title: Authentication
description: The authentication domain: gateway-fronted edge auth backed by Keycloak, with the caller resolved from the gateway's assertion and persisted in Postgres. Selecting it pulls Postgres for the user store and declares the gateway/Keycloak deployment secrets. Combined with FastAPI it activates the hidden fastapi-auth integration (the identity gate and Postgres user store); combined with a deployment capability it activates that deployment's hidden auth overlay (the gateway and Keycloak).
